answer: The permit costs 3 years of work and 300 dairy audits per name — cheap once, ruinous at farm scale. Without the voyage the claim cannot be checked, without the dawn the attack is cheap, and without the ivory the cheat is never caught. The gate asks for Exalted dairyman permit with dairymen attestation before the first reward — a permit dairymen renew after dairy audits. One real deed beats a thousand fake claims.
